title: Predicting Postoperative Anterior Chamber Depth, Intraocular Lens Tilt, and Decentration Using an Internally Validated Machine Learning Model.
summary: A prospective 49-patient cataract study used PLS regression and Random Forest to predict postoperative IOL position from preoperative biometry, reporting internal OOB error estimates. This is small-sample internal validation only.
